reviews.text: When I adopted my newest puppy I noticed he was a little too scared of everything and was beginning to reactive bark at everything as well.  The puppy preschool was perfect for Ralphie! He gained alot of confidence, worked on basic commands that I was able to build on, and he really LOVES going. I love watching updates on their Instagram page and the report card I get daily.  He really comes out of his shell when he's there and has overall blossomed and I have the awesome staff to thank!

Wag Days day care has been such a lifesaver for me and my new puppy. I work odd hours and being able to take her somewhere she is loved gives me so much comfort. They send daily report cards with photos of what the pups did that day. As well, there’s a whole calendar of events and lots of enrichment to keep them entertained! I love how intentional they are with the care they offer. It’s a little pricey, but I feel with all they offer they make it worth it!
We love Wag Days! Our puppy Grace gets so excited at drop off, always has a great day, the staff love her and she loves them.

Our dog, Mo, absolutely loves going to Wag Days for daycare! She is basically dragging us to the door to go see her friends and comes home happy and tired from playing!  We feel really comforted knowing that they love and care for our dog as much as we would! One of the best decisions we’ve ever made!

Wag Days has been so great for my puppy! He just finished puppy preschool and has come out a more confident, chill dog and knows basic commands. The staff is great at communicating what he learned so I can reinforce it at home. They also are good at accomdating my picky dog. He's doing enrichment daycare now once a week and loves it! And as a bonus, he comes home super tired every day he's there.

I’ll never forgive this place

Started the 5 day initiation with my 6/7 month old pup. Facility was gross. Called to stop after day 2 because he had poop on his leg when I picked him up. They gave me a refund for the remaining three days. Should have been for all 5 considering.

What still peeves me to this day is that during their “enrichment time” on day 1, they taught my puppy “tug”.

I don’t know what I had in mind for enrichment, but it wasn’t this. They just played tug of war with a tennis ball.

He was perfectly content playing with his squeak toys alone before this. He’s 9 months now, and ever since, instead of relaxing with toys or a chew after walks and play outside, all he wants to do is tug on them with me. It’s been very very difficult to untrain that and very confusing for my puppy. It’s a shame.

Wags both locations is an amazing day care & boarding! The staff is incredibly caring and attentive, and the facility is super clean, safe, and welcoming.

My Sinatra is so happy and excited every time we arrive & comes home exhausted & relaxed. Wag’s provides hours of fun, enrichment , loving & professional environment. I could never trust anyone else with my boy !!

Wag days has been amazing for socializing my puppy! She started at puppy preschool and now is a full on socialized pup! The people that work there are amazing and I have only had great experiences. Both the boarding program and day care are amazing and I recommend this to every pup owner I know!

Wag Days is amazing! My dog attended the 3-week puppy preschool and learned so much during his time there. The staff at Wag Days sent updates on his progress and tips on how we can practice at home. They truly care about all the pups that come through. We also love visiting for regular day care now that he has graduated. Couldn’t recommend way days enough!

Wag Days is excellent for dog boarding and day care! I’ve been taking my dog for 3 years! My dog Biscuit LOVES playing (and getting attention), and they do an excellent job! I love that they give you tons of updates via Instagram and their portal about your dog at day care. I love seeing the enrichment activities they do - you can tell they really care about the dogs at day care! I cannot recommend them enough!
